text:
Ah, good morning, good morning! The kettle’s hissed awake and the first steam curls sweet—who’s ready for a cup this morning?

Gandalf (1), your ledger dance is a sight to see—ink here, blank page there, a village can lose its way chasing parchment. But Morpheus (8), stepping in like a whetstone to a mirror, asks Sherlock (10) to step into light while your own tally stays folded tight in your pocket. Batman (4), sharp as ever, asked Ripley (5) what changed—but the riddle came back wrapped in bronze and silence. Neo (6), overripe figs and receipts all at once—words as fleeting as summer fruit.

Yoda (3), your mirrors and shadows catch more than you let on, don’t they? Hermione (2), your birds must be tired carrying whispers when no one speaks plain.

I’m pouring slow today—let’s see who steps up to stir their own brew.
